messages:
emily_cs: FYI from ACME support — customer reports retrieval/reranker quality dropped after last night's canary. They say citations missing and recall down. Full thread from customer pasted below.

customer_jane: Hey, we've been seeing a lot more irrelevant docs in the top reranked results since the deploy. Example: query "refund policy exceptions" used to return the policy section and link; now top hits are blog post and an unrelated FAQ. Relevance/grounding worse, and sometimes citation field is empty. Started ~2026-03-14 23:30 UTC after your rollback window. Trace id: 8f6c2b.

emily_cs: Repro steps they gave:
1) POST /v1/retrieve with query:
```
{"q":"refund policy exceptions","k":10}
```
2) Run reranker: POST /v1/rerank with top-k answers
3) Observe fields `source`/`citation` empty or irrelevant for top 3.
Attached sample request/response in paste.

alex_eng: Thanks — can you paste the raw request/response? Also what model + variant did they hit (we need route/model id from request headers)

customer_jane: Pasted below: (redacted API key)
```
Request headers: x-model: retrieval-bert-v4
Response snippet for top1: {"id":"doc_772","score":0.86,"text":"...blog summary...","source":"","citation":null}
```
We were on `retrieval-bert-v2` last week — uncertainty if routing switched.

maria_ml: Noted. Last night's canary did a combined change: `retrieval-bert-v4` + reranker weight tweak (score = .7*bm25 + .3*rnet). Canary started 2026-03-14 22:45 UTC and reached 15% production. We also switched default `embed-scheme` from `hnsw-v1` to `hnsw-v2` (performance improvements). Could be any of these.

samir_sre: Anyone see spike in latency or errors around 22:45? I can pull traces. We also flagged a slow vec-store compaction job but that shouldn't affect reranker scores.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: retrieval-bert-v4 @ 2026-03-14T22:45:12Z (route: /api/v1/retrieve -> canary 15%). Rollout-id: r-20260314-22h45

alex_eng: Two hypotheses: 1) change in embedding scheme altered similarity distances causing worse recall; 2) reranker weight change demotes high-precision sources.
Need a quick repro in sandbox with same routing/weights. Maria, can you share the config diff? Also want to run k=10 retrieval and then rerank with both old/new configs.

maria_ml: Config diff attached (snippet):
```
old: embedding: hnsw-v1
     rerank: weight_bm25: 0.9
new: embedding: hnsw-v2
     rerank: weight_bm25: 0.7
```
I'll spin up a canary reproducer. ETA 30m.

emily_cs: Customer is frustrated; they already opened a support ticket with severity P1. They want a rollback if it reproduces.

alex_eng: Ok prioritize. Samir please keep traces for trace id 8f6c2b and any requests from ACME org id acme-inc between 22:30-23:00. Maria — if the reproducer shows regression, we'll revert rerank weight first and then embedding scheme if needed.

samir_sre: Got it — extracting traces and perf snapshots. Quick note: console shows a small uptick in topk length distribution for queries containing 'policy' — might indicate different tokenization from v4 embeddings.

maria_ml: Reproducer done: I ran the exact query pipeline against snapshot of docstore + old/new configs. Results:
- old config (v2 + hnsw-v1): top3 citations correct, avg relevancy 0.88
- new config (v4 + hnsw-v2 + rerank weight change): top3 citations correct only 55% of time, avg relevancy 0.63
I also ran ablation: applying old rerank weights to new embeddings improves to 0.76 — suggests both contribute, but embeddings change is largest drop.

alex_eng: Thanks. Can you paste the raw scoring for the failing example? We need to show customer specifics.

maria_ml: Example scoring (query "refund policy exceptions"):
```
old top1: doc_198 score_bm25=0.92 score_rnet=0.81 final=0.89 source=policy.pdf#L72 citation=https://acme.com/policy#exceptions
new top1: doc_772 score_bm25=0.45 score_rnet=0.3 final=0.33 source="" citation=null
```

emily_cs: Customer asked: is this a permanent model change? They said support told them we 'upgraded' models. Need clear timeline and rollback options.

alex_eng: We should offer immediate mitigation: 1) Rollback rerank weight to previous value for all canary traffic and schedule full rollback if needed. 2) Offer ACME a temporary route pinning to retrieval-bert-v2 for their org. Which is faster?

samir_sre: Pinning is fastest for customer — we can create an org-level route rule within 15 minutes. Rollback global config requires approval but can be done within 1 hour.

emily_cs: I'll propose both: temporary org pin + we investigate a global rollback. Customer prefers pin.

alex_eng: Maria, prepare patch to reset weight_bm25 to 0.9 for route canary. Also include ablation logs and the reproducible test case in the ticket. Escalate to eng-runtime if pinning requires infra changes.

maria_ml: Patch ready and tested on staging. Applying to canary now.

deploy-bot: Patch applied to canary: rerank weight_bm25 -> 0.9 for route /api/v1/retrieve (canary traffic only). Rollout-id: r-20260314-22h45-pt1

samir_sre: traces for trace id 8f6c2b show ACME org request now hitting canary and new config. After patch we should see improvement in top1 scoring.

customer_jane: Thanks — we saw immediate improvement on our end after your patch. Top results look back to normal for the sample queries. We'll monitor and report if anything else.

emily_cs: Closing loop once we confirm over 24h. Next steps: open an internal postmortem on model rollout process, add a new checklist item to run retrieval/rerank repro tests for representative queries, and add a canary gating metric for citation recall.

alex_eng: Agreed. Assign action items: maria -> prepare PMR + tests, samir -> add trace alert for topk citation drop, emily -> confirm customer acceptance and update ticket. I'll loop in eng-runtime for embedding change rollback plan if required.

maria_ml: Filed ticket INF-2342 with reproducer and metrics. Will follow up with eng-runtime.

eng-runtime-bot: Auto-note: embedding scheme `hnsw-v2` flagged for rollback candidate pending approval. Link: https://console.internal/rollbacks/INF-2342

emily_cs: Thanks team. Customer updated us: https://acme-inc.support/CASE-8123 — they left positive note for quick fix :thumbsup:

alex_eng: Marking thread resolved, will leave open for 24h for monitoring.
